Return {ok, config, error}; failures have empty config, successes have null error. Preserve explicit false, zero, and empty strings.

import json, py_compile
from work import evaluate
py_compile.compile('work.py', doraise=True)
with open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)
with open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]
def ok(req, pol, cfg): assert evaluate(req,pol)=={'ok':True,'config':cfg,'error':None}
def fail(req, pol, err): assert evaluate(req,pol)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':err}
base={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}
ok({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},base,{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''})
ok({'layers':[{'i':9},{'i':None}]},base,{'b':True,'i':2,'s':'x'})
ok({'layers':[{'i':'bad'}],'environment':{'i':'-12','b':'false','s':''}},base,{'b':False,'i':-12,'s':''})
fail({'layers':[{'x':1}]},base,'unknown_key')
fail({'environment':{'x':'1'}},base,'unknown_key')
fail({'environment':{'b':'True'}},base,'environment')
fail({'environment':{'i':' 1'}},base,'environment')
fail({'environment':{'i':'1.0'}},base,'environment')
fail({'layers':[{'i':True}]},base,'type')
fail({'environment':{'i':'1'}},{**base,'environment':False},'environment')
print('all checks passed')
